rgb.basis: Official dimension drawing: 8.14 mm from bottom of 24 mm board; 4.56 mm left of center screw.

rgb.electricalAndOpticalScope: Actual G27 RMT output is verified numerically in the separate runtime/public-control records. No ledIndex optical surface is installed; diffuser depth, transmission and brightness remain unverified. No opening is fabricated through the actual cover or applied film.
